post.description:
Authenticate with email/password JSON body, OAuth2 form, or Google ID token.

- Default: JSON ``LoginRequest`` body
- ``?provider=google``: JSON ``GoogleLoginRequest`` with ``idToken``
- ``application/x-www-form-urlencoded``: OAuth2 password form (Swagger)

get.description: Current user and the workspaces they belong to, with their role in each.

post.description:
Bootstrap user registration for local/dev environments.
Disabled when APP_ENV=production. The new user belongs to no workspace: they create one
(``POST /workspaces``) or are added to one by a workspace lead.

get.description: The current user's tokens, newest first, including revoked and expired ones.

post.description:
Issue a personal access token acting as the current user, with their per-workspace roles.
Requires a login JWT: a personal access token cannot create another one.

delete.description: Revoke a token (soft delete, audited). It stops working immediately.

get.description: Members of the workspace named by the ``X-Titerlane-Workspace`` header.

post.description:
Build the samplesheet from the selected samples' verified FASTQ files, store it in S3 and
submit the Nextflow head job to AWS Batch. With AWS Batch disabled the run is recorded
as ``pending`` and not executed.

Endpoint passed to Nextflow as ``-with-weblog``. Authenticated by the per-run token in
the URL (Nextflow cannot send headers); not workspace-scoped and not for API clients.

get.description: Run log as JSON lines, for clients that poll instead of using the SSE stream.

Server-sent events: ``log`` for each run log line as it is written, ``status`` when the
run status changes, ``end`` once the run is finished, was never submitted, or after an
hour.

post.description:
Import samples from a UTF-8 CSV. Columns are the ``SampleCreate`` fields, in camelCase
(``sampleCode``) or snake_case (``sample_code``). Rows with a sample code that already
exists in the workspace, or appears twice in the file, are skipped and reported.
Create a workspace. The creator becomes its first ``bioinformatics_lead``.
